name: code-tabs
title: Code tabs
description: The same code in several languages or package managers as tabs that remember your choice across the page, with copy, a stable height and an optional localStorage key.
docs: Wrap the pages that show code in a CodeTabsProvider once, in a layout, and every CodeTabs with the same group switches together. storageKey keeps the choice in localStorage; it is read after the page has loaded, so the server and the first paint show defaultTab. All panels share one cell, so the block is as high as the tallest.
